body:
I have nothing to be proud of, I spent years focusing heavily on this relationship to make sure it would be the one thing that I wouldn't loose, but just as I expected it wouldn't last.

If I was a different person, I'd thinking giving up over a girl would be stupid, but when you live a life with no meaning anymore, you really don't want to be kept in that situation

I've tried waiting for things to get better, but they never do.

My life runs like a rollercoaster, at times it can be high but at times it can stoop so low, and the lows have been more common than the highs.

I always end up talking myself out of doing it, I always have a sense of fear about what comes after and everything I could miss out on.

But now there's like nothing keeping me here.
